title: Work out the rule
text:
Recall that to add two fractions, they must share a common denominator. The way to force that is to multiply each fraction by some clever form of the number $$1$$. 

$$ rac{x+1}{y-2}+ rac{y}{x**2+1}= rac{x+1}{y-2} rac{x**2+1}{x**2+1}+ rac{y}{x**2+1} rac{y-2}{y-2}$$ 
 This leads to the right hand side, which is encapsulated in the general rule $$ rac{a}{b}+ rac{c}{d}= rac{ad+bc}{bd}.$$
